description.value: Open since 1993 and planted at Roberts Creek's main three-way stop, The Gumboot Café is a long-standing community institution known for making everything in-house — from daily soups and multigrain loaves to a carrot cake recipe unchanged for three decades. The menu spans gourmet pizza, vegan and gluten-free classics, organic coffee, pastries, and local craft beer and wine, all sourced as locally and organically as possible. A touring cyclist pulling into Roberts Creek will find a genuinely beloved, unhurried stop with outdoor seating and real food made with care.
